transcript.text: ¡Hola! ¡Qué alegría verte otra vez! Soy Sparky, tu amigo dragón. Hoy mi familia espacial me vino a visitar y tengo muchas ganas de presentártelos. ¿Tenés ganas de conocerlos conmigo?
Hello! You sound so excited, I love it! Look, this is my big sister Zorg. She is very fast. Do you have a sister or a brother?
¡Yes! Tengo una hermana. Emmm... ella es fast?
¡Qué genial que tengas una hermana! Yes, she is fast, she runs very quickly like my sister Zorg. What is your sister's name?
¡Sí! Se llama Ana. ¡Mira, Ana corre rápido!
Wow, Ana is fast too! That is amazing. She sounds like a super sister. Is Ana happy today?

Yes, she is happy! You are doing a great job talking about Ana today. I loved meeting your sister, and next time you can tell me more about your friends too. You did an amazing job today, see you later!
